subject: Stale-opps cleanup + close-date lock request — finance needs final state
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: finance-ops@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stale-opps cleanup + close-date lock request — finance needs final state

Team —

Finance asked us for a final picture of commitable pipeline ahead of Thursday's forecast cutoff. I pulled a quick snapshot (attached) and there are ~18 opportunities on the Acme book that show stale close dates (<= 90d old) or no stage movement in 60+ days. If we don't resolve these, finance will remove them from the committed forecast which will materially change our number for the quarter.

Action requested: could each of you please do the following by EOD Wednesday (2/09):
- Review opportunities assigned to you in the attached CSV.
- For each opp, either:
  * Update stage to the current customer status (e.g., "Negotiation" -> "On Hold") and add a short note; OR
  * Lock the close date as firm with a one-sentence justification; OR
  * Mark as prospect/marketing-qualified if no active deal exists.

I flagged the highest-dollar items in the "priority" column. For Acme specifically, note that procurement asks to avoid surprise billing and wants all invoicing milestones locked in before final close. If Ben or Marissa want me to step into any ACME conversations to push dates, say the word.

Attachment: pipeline_snapshot_20270208.csv (includes: opp id, AE, ARR, stage, close_date, priority)

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Acme Analytics <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stale-opps cleanup + close-date lock request — finance needs final state

Thanks Rachel — pulling the list now. Quick notes on the Acme lines:
- Opp RINF-2027-ACME-42 (15k ARR): Close date shows 2026-11-30. Customer moved to a multi-month procurement review; finance is not comfortable counting this as commit. I'm going to update stage to "Procurement Review" and set close_date to 2027-03-31 pending PO. Adding comment referencing the procurement thread.
- Opp RINF-2027-ACME-31 (40k ARR): This one is active; legal accepted T&Cs last week. I'll lock the close date to 2027-02-28 and add the legal sign-off note.

I'll finish the rest of my list by EOD. If you want me to push for an accelerated PO on RINF-2027-ACME-42 I can coordinate with Procurement at Acme — looping them in.

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Feb 2027 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stale-opps cleanup + close-date lock request — finance needs final state

Copy — did a pass on the file and made updates for my book. Two quick asks I flagged for ops/AM:
1) Please confirm whether "proof-of-concept" opps should live in forecast if there is no signed SOW. My view: do not count POC opps as commit unless a signed SOW exists.
2) For opportunities moved to "On Hold", can we add a rollback tag so they are easy to re-open in the next hygiene sweep?

For Acme: I left a note on RINF-2027-ACME-42 referencing Ben's procurement comment and set tentative close to 2027-03-31. Ben — if you want, I'll take the lead on the PO nudge; I have an existing thread with their procurement manager and can try to get a hard PO date.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Acme Analytics <procurement@acme-analytics.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800

Hi Rachel / Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up and for the detailed notes in the CSV. Procurement confirms: for RINF-2027-ACME-42 we are targeting final approval by 2027-03-24, but that depends on a final security review (scheduled 2/20). We can provide a conditional PO by 2027-03-10 if Redwood can accept a 30-day payment term waiver in the SOW. Otherwise, the date is likely to slip.

For RINF-2027-ACME-31 the PO is ready; we will route it today for signatures and you should expect countersigned docs by 2027-02-25.

Attached: acme_ma_plan.pdf (procurement milestone summary)

Let us know if you need anything else to lock numbers for your finance team.
